title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
statement: Find the longest substring that can be made of one repeated uppercase letter by replacing at most k characters.
explanation: Maintain a window and the highest character frequency seen in it; shrink when window length minus that frequency exceeds k.

title: Construct Quad Tree
statement: Construct a quadtree representation of a square binary grid, where uniform regions become leaves.
explanation: If a region is uniform, create a leaf; otherwise split it into four equal quadrants and recurse.

title: N-ary Tree Level Order Traversal
statement: Return the values of an N-ary tree grouped by depth from top to bottom.
explanation: Use BFS and process the queue size captured at the start of each level.

title: Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List
statement: Flatten a multilevel doubly linked list so child lists appear immediately after their parent, preserving next/prev links.
explanation: Use a stack to defer each node's original next pointer when descending into a child list.

title: Minimum Genetic Mutation
statement: Find the minimum single-character mutations from startGene to endGene, using only valid genes in the bank.
explanation: BFS explores genes differing by one character and returns the first distance to endGene.

title: Non-overlapping Intervals
statement: Return the minimum number of intervals to remove so the remaining intervals do not overlap.
explanation: Sort by end time and greedily keep each interval whose start is at least the last kept end.

title: Path Sum III
statement: Count downward paths in a binary tree whose node values sum to targetSum; paths may start and end anywhere but must go downward.
explanation: Track prefix-sum frequencies along the current DFS path to count valid paths ending at each node.

title: Find All Anagrams in a String
statement: Return all starting indices where a substring of s is an anagram of p.
explanation: Maintain character counts for a window of length p and compare them with p's frequency counts.

title: K-th Smallest in Lexicographical Order
statement: Return the kth integer in lexicographical order among integers 1 through n.
explanation: Count how many numbers lie under each decimal prefix and skip whole prefix subtrees when k exceeds their size.

title: Arranging Coins
statement: Given n coins, return the number of complete staircase rows that can be formed.
explanation: Binary-search the largest k satisfying k(k+1)/2 <= n.
